senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) pr. n. gent. Ammon, a people descended from Ben Ammi, the son of Lot; mentioned chiefly in connection with Moab.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:3">Yad. IV, 3</cite> <he>ע׳ ומואב מעשרין וכ׳</he> Jewish inhabitants of the land of A. a. M. must give the poor man’s tithes in the Sabbatical years; <cite ref="Yevamot 16a:10">Yeb. 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 3b:9">Ḥag. 3ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 38a:3">Gitt. 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 60b:13">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00602"><he>סִיחוֹן</he></cite>; a. fr.
